brief:
The United Nations warned that one-quarter of Gaza's households are headed by women enduring severe psychological burdens, Shehab Wire reported. The alert comes amid acute shortages in humanitarian aid funding and widespread damage to educational facilities.

One-third of education sites in Gaza have been damaged by rainfall, compounding challenges for families already struggling with displacement, economic collapse, and limited access to basic services. Women heads of household typically bear heightened responsibility for sustaining families while contending with trauma and insecurity.

title: UN says quarter of Gaza families headed by women facing severe stress
